evidence.quote: [/page/2/Text/1] In our design, a participant thus decides twice. In the baseline she first decides on behalf of herself, then on behalf of a third party. In the treatment, we swap the order.
[/page/3/Text/4] We ran the experiment in the lab of the Max Planck Institute for Research on Collective Goods in Bonn.

The abstract mentions a 'modified dictator game that allows for "moral wiggle room"' but does not specify any monetary cost for information revelation. By default, information cost is 0.0 unless explicitly stated otherwise.
